A1.name: Chào hỏi và giới thiệu bản thân
A1.why: The first sentences everyone needs: name, age (numbers 1–100), hometown. Comes with the verb to be and subject pronouns.

A1.name: Gia đình
A1.why: The most familiar vocabulary; practises have / has and possessive adjectives.

A1.name: Thời gian và ngày tháng
A1.why: Clock times, days, months and ordinal numbers with at / on / in, and question words: needed before talking about routines.

A1.name: Nhà cửa và đồ đạc
A1.why: There is / there are and prepositions of place.

A1.name: Hoạt động hằng ngày
A1.why: Present simple and adverbs of frequency, reusing the clock times just learned.

A1.name: Đồ ăn
A1.why: A / an / the and plural nouns; saying what you eat, ordering food.

A1.name: Mua sắm
A1.why: This / that / these / those, asking prices (larger numbers), colours and clothes sizes: reuses the food and numbers already learned.

A1.name: Trường học
A1.why: Present simple negatives and questions (I don’t…, Do you…?).

A1.name: Âm nhạc
A1.why: Like / love + V-ing and and / but / because; easy to link to songs.

A1.name: Thời tiết
A1.why: Reviews the present simple and adverbs of frequency; leads into seasons and travel at A2.

A1.name: Con vật
A1.why: Can / can’t for ability; memorable vocabulary that is easy to picture.

A1.name: Thành phố và chỉ đường
A1.why: Imperatives and prepositions of place: asking for and giving directions.

A2.name: Quần áo
A2.why: Present continuous to describe what someone is wearing (She is wearing…), too / enough when trying clothes on (too big, not long enough), possessive pronouns (Whose is this? It’s mine). Follows Shopping at A1.

A2.name: Nghề nghiệp
A2.why: Present simple versus present continuous (I usually work…, this week I’m working…), have to / don’t have to for duties at work, will for dreams.

A2.name: Miêu tả người
A2.why: Comparatives, superlatives and as … as: comparing family members and friends.

A2.name: Nhà hàng và gọi món
A2.why: Would like, Can / Could I…?, countable and uncountable nouns (some / any, much / many, a few / a little); reuses the A1 food vocabulary.

A2.name: Bạn bè và các mối quan hệ
A2.why: The first stories in the past: was / were, regular past simple and Did you…? questions through stories of meeting people; could for what someone was able to do in the past.

A2.name: Thể thao
A2.why: Irregular past simple to tell about a match (won, lost, went), adverbs of manner (played well, ran fast); play / do / go.

A2.name: Giao thông
A2.why: Must / mustn’t / don’t have to for traffic rules, prepositions of movement (along, across, through), by bus / on foot; follows directions at A1.

A2.name: Sức khoẻ
A2.why: Should / shouldn’t for advice, the zero conditional (If you eat too much, you feel sick); body parts and symptoms.

A2.name: Du lịch
A2.why: Be going to and the present continuous for plans and bookings; will for decisions made on the spot; past continuous to tell about a trip (While we were walking, it started to rain).

A2.name: Tết
A2.why: A familiar culture, so easy to talk about; telling about last year’s Tết in the past simple, indefinite pronouns (everyone, something, nowhere) to describe customs.

B1.name: Công nghệ, internet và mạng xã hội
B1.why: Gerund or to-infinitive (enjoy using, decide to buy), phrasal verbs (log in, turn off); starts giving advantages and disadvantages.

B1.name: Công việc
B1.why: Present perfect for experience (Have you ever…?, for / since, already / yet) and how it differs from the past simple; job interviews, CVs.

B1.name: Tuổi thơ và kỷ niệm
B1.why: Used to for past habits, make / let for what parents made or let you do; comparing the past and now.

B1.name: Tính cách
B1.why: -ed / -ing adjectives, so / such … that, reflexive pronouns; finer vocabulary than Describing people, giving examples to support a point.

B1.name: Phim ảnh
B1.why: Retelling a plot with defining relative clauses, guessing what happens with must / might / can’t; giving your impressions.

B1.name: Sách và đọc
B1.why: Past perfect with the past simple when telling a story (When she arrived, he had left).

B1.name: Khách sạn và sân bay
B1.why: Real situations when travelling; polite indirect questions (Could you tell me where…?), question tags to check information.

B1.name: Điện thoại và giao tiếp
B1.why: Making calls and leaving messages: reported speech; so / neither to agree.

B1.name: Thiên nhiên và địa lý
B1.why: The passive (is found, was built); comparing regions and countries.

B1.name: Môi trường
B1.why: First and second conditionals to suggest solutions, present perfect continuous (temperatures have been rising); prepares for B2.

B2.name: Giáo dục đại học và du học
B2.why: Be / get used to for life in a new place, wish / if only, would rather and It’s time; arguing advantages and disadvantages.

B2.name: Những lựa chọn trong cuộc sống
B2.why: Third and mixed conditionals, should have / could have: looking back on past decisions, regrets and lessons learned.

B2.name: Báo chí và truyền thông
B2.why: Telling fact from opinion; the passive in all tenses, reported questions and reporting verbs (deny, admit, warn).

B2.name: Kinh doanh và văn phòng
B2.why: Formal language for emails, meetings and negotiation; be supposed to / be allowed to / needn’t, future perfect (By Friday we will have finished), as long as / provided that.

B2.name: Khoa học và phát minh
B2.why: Explaining processes, causes and effects; participle clauses and non-defining relative clauses (Penicillin, which was discovered in 1928, …).

B2.name: Lịch sử
B2.why: Narrative tenses and the past perfect continuous; negative inversion (Never before had…) to tell about striking events.

B2.name: Nghệ thuật và văn hoá
B2.why: Giving reasoned opinions; contrast linkers (although, despite, however), both / either / neither to compare works.

B2.name: Thời trang
B2.why: The causative (have my hair cut, get it altered), trends and consumption; gentle debate.

C1.name: Tâm lý học
C1.why: Hedging (tends to, it would appear that) and cleft sentences (What matters is…); academic vocabulary.

C1.name: Pháp luật và tội phạm
C1.why: The passive with reporting verbs (He is believed to…), the subjunctive (insist that he be); specialist vocabulary.

C1.name: Xã hội và các vấn đề toàn cầu
C1.why: Arguing several sides; inverted conditionals (Were governments to…, Should this happen…), discourse markers.

C1.name: Y học và sức khoẻ cộng đồng
C1.why: Nominalisation for concise writing (the reduction in…, the spread of…); reading and summarising research reports.

C1.name: Quảng cáo và tiêu dùng
C1.why: Advanced inversion (Not only… but also), emphatic do / does, whatever / however: the language of persuasion.

C1.name: Ngôn ngữ và giao tiếp
C1.why: Ellipsis and substitution (I hope not, do so, I’d love to): speaking naturally without repeating words; cultural differences in communication.

C1.name: Nhân vật và tiểu sử
C1.why: Future in the past (was about to, would later become) to tell the life of an inspiring person.

C2.name: Đạo đức và triết lý
C2.why: Debating values; concession and emphasis (much as, be that as it may), modal nuance (may well, might as well).

C2.name: Kinh tế toàn cầu
C2.why: Analysing data and trends; complex noun phrases (a sharp rise in youth unemployment) and the more …, the more ….

C2.name: Văn học và phê bình
C2.why: Fronting (Such was his anger that…) and complex noun phrases to comment on literary works.

C2.name: Chính trị và ngoại giao
C2.why: Formal style (to whom, impersonal it) against everyday speech; modal nuance to speak tactfully and noncommittally.

C2.name: Khoa học và tương lai nhân loại
C2.why: Artificial intelligence and bioethics; concession (however promising, much as) and nuanced prediction (is bound to, may well).

C2.name: Hài hước và ngôn ngữ đời thường
C2.why: Informal style and ellipsis; fixed frames (if anything, as it were, so to speak).

C2.name: Bản sắc và văn hoá
C2.why: Migration, globalisation and identity; fronting and concession in essay writing.
